A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa system]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. This battle took part of the offensive launched by [[reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to reconquer the last [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] strongholds following the capture of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] by the reunified [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its unique appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the conflict.<ref name="Atlas" />
